name: SPA-Bench
description: SPA-Bench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate (Multimodal) Large Language Model-based smartphone agents in an interactive environment simulating real-world conditions. It includes diverse tasks covering system and third-party apps in English and Chinese, and features a plug-and-play framework for real-time agent interaction with Android devices. The benchmark assesses agent performance across multiple dimensions including task completion and resource consumption.
reputation: A new benchmark for smartphone agents that is gaining attention in the multimodal agent community, but it is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Includes tasks in English and Chinese; evaluates multiple dimensions including resource consumption; supports real-time interaction with Android devices.
